name: SikaBond-142 Instant Nails
paste:
SIKABOND®-142 INSTANT NAILS: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails, August 2025, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/sikabond_-142_instantnails.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2025, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails is a high strength contruction adhesive that will not slump on vertical surfaces. It can be used as a one way liquid adhesive, or a two way contact adhesive, on a variety of surfaces.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails can be used on a variety of substrates due to its excellent adhesion.
    - Floor and wall panels
    - Timber, particleboard, MDF and plywood
    - Aluminium, iron and steel
    - Concrete, cement sheeting, fibreglass and masonry
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: HIGH STRENGTH MULTIPURPOSE ADHESIVE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2025, Version 01.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS 2329: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - One component ready to use
    - Fast drying time
    - Easy to use
    - High adhesion strength
    - Non-slump
    - Paintable
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: 1-component synthetic rubber dispersion
    - Colour: Beige
    - Density: ~1.1 kg/l
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Tensile strength: >1MPa (dry substrate) (AS 2329)
    - Adhesion in peel: >40N
    - Yield: ~15 linear metres for a continuous 5mm bead
    - Curing time: Full cure in approximately 7 days, depending on weather conditions.
    - Skinning time: 1-5 Minutes
2.7 Service temperature.
    | Maximum | +40°C |
    | Minimum | 0°C |
2.8 Substrate temperature.
    | Maximum | +40°C |
    | Minimum | +5°C |
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 300 gr cartridge, 12 cartridges per carton; 300 gr cartridge, 6 cartridges per carton; 300 gr cartridge, 3 cartridges per pack
    - Shelf life: 18 months from date of production
2.10 Storage conditions. The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. The substrate must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, cement laitance, old sealants and poorly bonded coatings which could affect adhesion, light abrasion is recommended for improved adhesion.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - One Way Method: This method is recommended for heavier panels or where load or stress is expected. Apply a 4 to 6mm bead of SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails using a cartridge gun, making sure the beads are no more than 45cm apart. Bring both substrates immediately together and clamp, nail or screw for a minimum of 24 hours. For butt joints use adhesive on both panel edges.
    - Two Way Method: Apply adhesive as in one way method, bring together substrates, and press firmly over entire surface to transfer adhesive. Then pull apart, allow adhesive to tack off for 3 to 5 minutes, reposition the objects and press together firmly. The surfaces should be tapped together with a hammer and a padded block to ensure maximum contact. Maximum bond strength will be achieved in 12 to 72 hours, heavy panels may require temporary mechanical fastening until maximum strength is achieved.
4.3 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and equipment immediately after use with Sika® Colma Cleaner or mineral turpentine. Cured material can only be removed mechanically.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations - Limitations.
    - SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails is not suitable for immersed applications
    - Do not apply SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails at temperatures below +5°C
    - Do not apply SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails on damp, unseasoned or treated timber

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.4):
    - Do not apply SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails at temperatures below +5°C
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Tensile strength: >1MPa (dry substrate) (AS 2329)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails, August 2025, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/sikabond_-142_instantnails.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaBond®142 Instant Nails, version 01/07/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sds-sikabond-142instantnails.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaBond®142 Instant Nails TRADE PACK, version 01/07/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sds-sikabond-142instantnailstradepack.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaBond 142 Instant Nails, version 28/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/MSDS%20SikaBond%20142%20Instant%20Nails%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
